propwash.server.tab.readonly:
Read only: the server sets these values.
File: config/propwash/server.json, reload with /propwash reload.
gamerule.propwash.gravity_scale.descript: Gravity for drones in percent of Earth's gravity (100 = 9.81 m/s², 0 = weightless). Higher: drones fall faster and need more throttle to hover; they only take off while their thrust-to-weight ratio from the workbench is above the factor. The workbench and overview always calculate with real Earth gravity.
gamerule.propwash.prop_wash.description: Turbulence when a drone descends through its own downwash.
gamerule.propwash.ground_effect.descript: Extra lift close to the ground.
gamerule.propwash.hardware_limits.descri: On: hot motors throttle back and wear out, and an ESC burns out on arming when the battery has more cells than it allows. Off: no thermal throttling, no heat wear, no burnt ESC.
gamerule.propwash.part_compatibility.des: On: the workbench, imports and field service only build drones from parts that would fit together in reality (mounts, prop size, battery for the frame, accessory mounts). Off: every part fits every other. The notes stay visible, the drone flies with the real data of its parts and doesn't count for leaderboards. Overvoltage is still governed by “Hardware limits”.
gamerule.propwash.wind.description: Strength of wind and gusts. Off: calm. Mild: wind depends on weather and height, almost calm under a roof (default). Windy: twice as strong. Storm: three times as strong – in a thunderstorm small drones can barely fly against it.
gamerule.propwash.turbulence.description: Rough air: gusts and the shaking in the drone's own downwash. Off: the wind blows steadily.
gamerule.propwash.battery_scale.descript: How long a battery lasts, in percent: 200 twice as long, 50 half as long, 0 infinite (the battery does not drain while flying). The mAh drawn in the OSD count along.
gamerule.propwash.battery_sag.descriptio: On: battery voltage falls as the pack drains, a nearly empty pack sags much harder on a punch, and the drone gets weaker towards the end. Off: the pack behaves like a full one until it is empty. Load sag from the internal resistance stays either way.
gamerule.propwash.crash_damage.descripti: Crashes wear the parts down: props first, motors, camera and frame much later. Also covers heat wear and burnt ESCs. Off: parts never wear.
gamerule.propwash.crash_damage_scale.des: How much crashes wear the parts, in percent; 100 is normal. Only with crash damage on.
gamerule.propwash.crash_tolerance.descri: The impact speed from which a hit counts as a crash, in percent; 100 is normal, higher is more forgiving.
gamerule.propwash.crash_disarm.descripti: On: after a hard impact the flight controller shuts the motors off, like crash detection on a real quad. Off: the drone stays armed after crashes – fly on, or flip it back over with turtle mode while it lies upside down.
gamerule.propwash.prop_strikes.descripti: A prop clipping an obstacle slows its motor and sends the drone tumbling.
Drones with analog video: picture and radio link never drop – neither with distance nor behind obstacles. The server's distance limit still applies.
gamerule.propwash.infinite_range_digital: Drones with digital video: picture and radio link never drop – neither with distance nor behind obstacles. The server's distance limit still applies.
gamerule.propwash.max_video_channels.des: How many video transmitters may be on air at the same time – like the frequency board at a race. When every channel is taken, no further drone can take off until a pilot lands. Pilots already in the air keep flying. 0 = unlimited.
propwash.server.world_rules.footer: Applies to everyone in this world – saved with the world
propwash.server.world_rules.intro: These rules apply to every player in this world. A preset applies at once, single rules when you save. Flights with changed physics do not count for leaderboards.
propwash.server.world_rules.read_only: Read only: whoever may use /gamerule changes the world rules, in singleplayer the host. This shows what applies in this world.
propwash.server.world_rules.unknown: This world has not sent its rules yet – the defaults apply.
propwash.server.world_rules.command_hint: By command: /gamerule propwash:<rule> <value>, for example /gamerule propwash:wind 2, or all at once with /propwash rules preset training. Values apply per world.
propwash.server.world_rules.denied: You don't have permission to change world rules.
propwash.server.deny.channels_full: All %s video channels are in use. Wait until a pilot lands.
propwash.server.deny.parts_incompatible: This drone's parts don't fit together. The world rule “Parts must fit” is on.
propwash.server.world_rules.footer_read_: Read only – changed by the host and whoever may use /gamerule
propwash.server.world_rules.preset.reali: Every rule at its default – Propwash as it comes. Flights count for leaderboards.
propwash.server.world_rules.preset.train: Practice without consequences: no wear and no prop strikes, the battery never runs empty or sags and motors never overheat – the drone keeps its full power. Wind and air stay as in Realistic. Lap times are saved with the badge “Assisted”.
propwash.server.world_rules.preset.arcad: Like Training, plus full freedom: any part fits any other, the air is calm, the drone shrugs off hard hits and keeps flying, and water does not hurt it.
propwash.server.world_rules.preset.insta: Applies at once to everyone in this world.
propwash.server.world_rules.preset.apply: Preset “%s” set – applies to everyone in this world
propwash.server.world_rules.preset_appli: %s set the world rules to the "%s" preset.
gamerule.propwash.drones_generate_chunks: On: when a drone flies past the edge of the world generated so far, new terrain is created there – as if a player walked there (as before). Off: drones only load terrain that already exists. At the edge the drone brakes gently and stops just short of it, the OSD shows “WORLD EDGE” and the FPV view has no holes. Saves server time; GPS rescue without pilot never flies into unexplored terrain anyway. The server config (server.json) can additionally limit generation to permission levels.
